# llms.txt — curated external references

> Not a site index (llms.txt's original convention) — a maintained link list
> for this repo. Referenced from AGENTS.md; not loaded by default. Update
> this file, not AGENTS.md, when a new source or doc link is added.

## Papers (full text lives in docs/source/*.md as trimmed extracts — these
## are the canonical citations, use them in write-ups, not the local copy)

- Bandi & Su, "(Early) AI Compute Asset Pricing" — arXiv:2607.12156 (July 2026)
  https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.12156
  Local extract: docs/source/AiComputeAssetPricing.md
  Use for: no-arbitrage pricing of compute futures, synthetic futures
  construction, risk premium framework.

- Talluri & van Ryzin, "An Analysis of Bid-Price Controls for Network Revenue
  Management" — Management Science 44(11), Nov 1998
  Local extract: docs/source/network_revenue_management.md
  Use for: network/bundle bid formulation, why bid-price control is
  non-optimal, DLP, stranding cost.

- van Ryzin & Talluri, "An Introduction to Revenue Management" — INFORMS
  TutORials in Operations Research, 2005/reissued 2014
  Local extract: docs/source/van-ryzin-talluri-2014-an-introduction-to-revenue-management.md
  Use for: single-resource displacement cost, bid-price vocabulary, dynamic
  model Bellman formulation.

- Ornn, "The Basis Gap in Compute Acquisition Structures" (vocabulary source,
  not separately extracted — read directly if needed)

- a16z crypto, "Investing in Ornn" (thesis framing, not separately extracted)

- Littlewood (1972) — two-class marginal seat revenue, not separately
  extracted; short enough to read directly when needed.

- Schwartz (1997), "The Stochastic Behavior of Commodity Prices" —
  one-factor mean-reverting model. Not extracted; needed for Day 2 price-
  process work.

- Lucia & Schwartz (2002) — mean reversion plus jumps, fit to Nordic power.
  Not extracted; needed for Day 2 price-process work.

## Data sources — free tier only, per AGENTS.md non-negotiables

- Ornn OCPI free tier — https://api.ornnai.com (no key; 3mo daily, 5 GPU
  types; hourly current-price updates). Primary compute price series.
- PJM Data Miner 2 — https://dataminer2.pjm.com (free, registration only).
  Estimator validation set (known mean-reverting-with-spikes reference).
- CAISO OASIS — free. Alternate/secondary LMP source.
- AWS EC2 Spot price history — free with AWS account
  (`describe-spot-price-history`). Cross-zone dispersion = empirical basis
  proxy.
- AWS Price List API — free, public. On-demand + 1yr + 3yr reserved rates;
  synthetic forward curve input (Bandi & Su construction).
- CoreWeave SEC filings — https://www.sec.gov/edgar (EDGAR, free). Cost-basis
  range from depreciation schedules and utilization commentary.
- Public provider price pages — Vast.ai, RunPod, Lambda. Second basis-error
  measurement (cross-provider dispersion, identical hardware).
- Epoch AI GPU dataset — open. H100-equivalent conversion factors.

Explicitly excluded (do not integrate, even if convenient):
Ornn's paid historical tier, Silicon Data term curves, any private venue data.

## Institutional / methodology references (write-up material, Day 7)

- PJM LMP and hub overview — market-clearing-produced benchmark analogue.
- FERC Order 888 — institutional-sequencing analogue for compute market maturation.
- S&P/Case-Shiller methodology doc — hedonic index worked example (GPU
  heterogeneity analogue).
- IOSCO Principles for Financial Benchmarks — index-construction grounding.
